sources.evidence: Fetched 2026-08-09. URL CORRECTED: original /jobs/ showed 'All Jobs (321)' but that is the whole YM Careers network, not vascular. /jobs/function/vascular/ returns 'All Jobs (31)' true vascular postings, e.g. 'Vascular Surgeon - $1M 1st Year Income, No Call' (Clinical Strategy Partners, TX), 'Vascular Surgeon' (Cleveland Clinic, Stuart FL), 'Division Director, Vascular & Endovascular Surgery' (Jefferson Health, Philadelphia). Probed 11 RSS/JSON paths (/jobsrss/, /jobs/rss/, /rss, /feed, /jobs.rss, /jobs/feed, ?view=rss ...): /jobsrss/ 404s, /jobs/rss/ silently returns the HTML jobs page, and the page HTML contains zero application/rss+xml link tags. mr=none confirmed correct.
sources.note: Flagship US vascular board. Shares one job pool with entries 2-7 (FACS vascular filter returns the identical count of 31) — expect heavy cross-source duplication; dedupe by employer+title.

sources.name: StatRad — Teleradiologist openings
sources.evidence: Loads and shows a small but genuine openings list, not a generic recruiting pitch. Three positions with individual Apply links: 'Part-Time Teleradiologist' (Remote), 'Full-Time Teleradiologist' (Remote), and 'DevOps Engineer' (Hybrid, San Diego CA). Page states 'We are actively hiring several positions within our teleradiology operations team.'

Self-hosted; scrape the page.

sources.name: USAJOBS REST API (federal / VA / DHA)
sources.evidence: Endpoint is live and correct but key-gated: unauthenticated call returns a clean JSON 401 {"title":"Unauthorized","status":401}, proving the route exists. Developer portal (HTTP 200) documents "GET /api/Search" plus RSS feeds and job exports. Confirmed the underlying data is real and highly relevant by loading the public search in a browser: "1 – 25 of 152 jobs" for diagnostic radiologist, e.g. "Diagnostic Radiologist — Veterans Health Administration, Fayetteville NC, starting $360,000/yr (VM 15)" and Durham NC at $380,000/yr.
sources.note: Free self-serve API key from developer.usajobs.gov; requires Authorization-Key header plus a User-Agent set to the registered email. Nearly all hits are VA/VHA — strong, uncontested lane with real posted salaries.

sources.name: Weatherby Healthcare (CHG Healthcare)
sources.evidence: Base URL loads and DOES server-render inventory: "Showing 1 - 25 of 1585 jobs" with real cards, e.g. "Facility in Indiana Seeks a Locums Anesthesiologist", Carmel IN, JOB-3370949. SPECIALTY CORRECTED from "both" to radiology-only: I pulled Weatherby's own 81-slug specialty list from the page and there is NO vascular-surgery slug — the closest are cardiovascular-surgery and cardio-thoracic-surgery. Valid radiology slugs exist (radiology, interventional-radiology, pediatric-radiology).
sources.note: Sweep the BASE /locum-tenens-jobs URL only. The specialty subpages (/locum-tenens-jobs/physician/radiology etc.) are Livewire-hydrated and server-render zero job IDs — they render "No results found" to any fetcher, which is a rendering artifact, not an empty board. Weatherby jobs also surface on HospitalRecruiting tagged "WBY# JOB-" — dedupe.
